name: Switchyard earth-grid main connection
aliases: switchyards Switchyard earthing and lightning interfaces
summary: Identifies the assigned main connection between equipment earthing and the station earth-grid system.
description: Identifies the assigned main connection between equipment earthing and the station earth-grid system. Earthing and lightning interfaces identify the connections between equipment metalwork, primary protection devices and the station earthing network. Their electrical purpose differs from their physical conductor route or electrode geometry.

In a switchyard arrangement, the earthing references help connect each primary equipment structure and surge-protection device to the correct earth-grid interface. Separate details show actual joints, sizes and installation routes. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Equipment earthing network” at the input and “Station earth grid” at the output. Grid performance requires a site-specific earthing study.

Name every connected item and the earthing design reference. The illustrative connection does not establish touch or step voltages, conductor sizing, lightning coverage or safe working conditions.
